sections.heading: Overview
bullets: A scripted crossing event between Soulless Horror and the Statues of Grenth. We haven't verified detailed pathing/callouts for this one yet — follow your commander's lead for now.

sections.heading: What we know
bullets: Named attacks in this encounter are Soul Siphon, Soul Wave, and Soulless Torrent — expect AoE waves to dodge while the squad advances.
Treat this as a positioning/movement check rather than a burst-damage check.
